name: Slovenian distance toll (DarsGo)
law: Cenik cestnine za uporabo cestninskih cest (Uradni list RS, št. 14/18, 74/18, 85/20, 105/20 in 57/24), NPB 4, with its annex: infrastructure charge per toll section, toll class and EURO class, in euros excluding VAT (22% VAT is charged on the toll); Sklep o uvedbi pribitka k cestnini na določenih odsekih cestninskih cest (Uradni list RS, št. 81/18 ... 118/23), NPB 6, art. 2 and 3; Uredba o cestnini za uporabo cestnega predora Karavanke (Uradni list RS, št. 14/18 ... 53/24), NPB 7, art. 3. Read from PISRS (pisrs.si); each act's date of application from its register data. Section places and lengths as in the 2026 table (Uredba o cestninskih cestah in cestnini, Annex).

vehicles: Motor vehicles over 3.5 t technically permissible maximum mass: R2 two axles, R3 three, R4 more than three
tolled_roads: The DARS motorway and expressway network, 127 toll sections; a section is charged when the route passes both of its ends. The Karavanke tunnel's Slovenian toll is a fixed amount per passage (Uredba o cestnini za uporabo cestnega predora Karavanke (Uradni list RS, št. 14/18 ... 53/24), NPB 7, art. 3: R2 4.51, R3 5.01, R4 10.01 EUR excluding VAT).

sections.law: Cenik cestnine za uporabo cestninskih cest (Uradni list RS, št. 14/18, 74/18, 85/20, 105/20 in 57/24), NPB 4, with its annex; columns EURO 0-III, IV, V, EEV/VI as the price list gives them, EURO VI's price in all its CO2 columns
sections.tariff_groups: Toll classes R2 (2 axles), R3 (3), R4 (more than 3); columns EURO 0-III, IV, V, EEV, VI with CO2 class 1, then EURO VI with CO2 classes 2-5. EEV is priced as EURO V here.

from.name: State border in the Karavanke tunnel (approx., mid-tunnel)

per_km.name: Surcharge for the Divača-Koper second rail track
per_km.law: Sklep o uvedbi pribitka k cestnini na določenih odsekih cestninskih cest (Uradni list RS, št. 81/18 ... 118/23), NPB 6, art. 2 (a) and 3 (b): EUR per km of the section's length, to 31 December 2052
